net_new_findings.title: AT-280 enforcement location remains claim/implementation ambiguity
net_new_findings.description: Story still requires a concrete enforcement point decision for AT-280 (inline quantize path vs explicit units-consistency function) and a single causality test asserting reject reason + dispatch_count.

net_new_findings.title: Non-ASCII separator fallback needs mandatory fixture coverage
net_new_findings.description: The fallback behavior in `§2` assumption 3 is strong, but currently only documented as an assumption; cross-reviews request at least one explicit fixture-based negative test.

net_new_findings.title: Single-parser ownership for `s4:` labels
net_new_findings.description: Multiple stories rely on shared label format; without a canonical-construction invariant, drift is possible if non-`label.rs` code paths emit labels.

net_new_findings.title: Ensure PRD-only reason-code identifiers are never emitted as primary rejects
net_new_findings.description: Decision to treat PRD-only codes as diagnostics should be enforced with negative tests to prevent future emission as primary reject codes.
